title: PH60111: Crystallographic Computation And Structure Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Computation of scattering factor, structure factor and Fourier coefficients
from the experimental data collected from photographic and counter methods;
data analysis, statistical analysis; Wilson plot; phase problems; different
methods of structural analysis; computation of pattern function and its
analysis to structurally determine heavy atom positions. Structure factor
calculation in different methods of analysis. Normal structure factor
calculation and its applications to direct method. Least-squares refinements of
crystal structure. Computation of bond length, bond angle and thermal
parameters. Description of some protein structures.
